entities.summary: Nicolas de Neufville, 1st Duke of Villeroy was a French nobleman and marshal. He was marquis then 1st duke of Villeroy and peer of France, marquis d'Alincourt and lord of Magny, and acted as governor of the young Louis XIV. His son François succeeded him as duke. He was the lover of Catherine-Charlotte de Gramont.
